name: Voronoi, Collatz and wavelet noise (sonar)
plain: Structured noises that go beyond spectrum tweaks. Voronoi uses cellular distance features with many modes. Collatz iterates the 3n+1 rule across dimension chains. Wavelet builds octaves of filtered noise.
math:
Voronoi: distance_mode in {euclidean, manhattan, chebyshev, minkowski, quadratic, angle, weight, …}; result_mode in {f1…f4, diff, cellid, ridge, softmin, median_distance, …}; default n_points 32 per slice; z evolves by z_increment.
Collatz: starts from uniform range, chained along a dim; multipliers and additions tracked separately for even and odd values with resets (read in part); then normalized.
Wavelet: octaves with wavelet filter blends.
